name: Chakra Strike (Akashic)
body:
You can channel akasha into your precision-based attacks, damaging your foe’s inner energy and body simultaneously.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, sneak attack or studied strike class feature.

Benefit(s): You can invest essence into this feat. You gain an insight bonus on damage rolls made when delivering attacks with the sneak attack or studied strike class features equal to twice the invested essence.

You gain 1 point of essence.
